2607.16760.title: Spatiotemporal Facial Action Unit Detection using Twin Cycle Autoencoders for Driver Monitoring
2607.16760.paper_summary: Driver monitoring systems (DMS) increasingly rely on facial cues to infer drowsiness, distraction, and cognitive load in real time. Facial Action Units (AUs), grounded in the Facial Action Coding System (FACS), provide an objective and interpretable representation of such states, but their automatic detection in the driving context is complicated by low and variable illumination, partial occlusion, head-pose variation, and the subtlety and short duration of relevant AU activations. Existing AU detectors largely treat spatial appearance and temporal dynamics separately, limiting their ability to exploit self-supervisory signal from abundant unlabeled driving video. We propose the Twin Cycle Autoencoder (TCA), a spatiotemporal architecture composed of two coupled cycle-consistent autoencoder branches: a Spatial Cycle Autoencoder that disentangles AU-relevant appearance from identity through image-level cycle consistency, and a Temporal Cycle Autoencoder that enforces forward-backward consistency over latent AU trajectories to capture onset-apex-offset dynamics. The two branches are coupled through a cross-branch latent alignment loss and fused via an attention module before multi-label AU classification. We evaluate TCA on the DISFA and BP4D benchmarks and on an in-cabin naturalistic driving dataset, and observe consistent improvements over CNN-RNN, 3D-CNN, and graph-based AU baselines, particularly for low-intensity and rapidly transitioning AUs relevant to fatigue (AU45, AU43) and yawning (AU26). We further show the model sustains real-time throughput on an embedded Jetson Xavier NX platform, supporting its use in production-grade advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS).
2607.16760.paper_summary_zh: 駕駛者監控系統 (DMS) 越來越依賴面部線索來即時推斷疲勞、分心和認知負荷。面部動作單元 (AUs)，基於面部動作編碼系統 (FACS)，提供了這些狀態的客觀和可解釋的表徵，但在駕駛環境中自動檢測它們受到低且變化不定的光照、部分遮擋、頭部姿勢變化以及相關 AU 激活的微妙性和短暫性的影響。現有的 AU 檢測器在很大程度上將空間外觀和時間動態分開處理，限制了它們利用大量未標記的駕駛視頻中的自我監督信號的能力。我們提出了雙循環自編碼器 (TCA)，這是一種時空架構，由兩個耦合的循環一致性自編碼器分支組成：一個空間循環自編碼器通過影像級循環一致性將與 AU 相關的外觀與身份解耦，另一個時間循環自編碼器則對潛在 AU 軌跡施加前後一致性，以捕捉啟動-頂峰-結束的動態。這兩個分支通過跨分支潛在對齊損失耦合，並在多標籤 AU 分類之前通過注意力模塊融合。我們在 DISFA 和 BP4D 基準以及一個駕駛艙自然駕駛數據集上評估 TCA，並觀察到相較於 CNN-RNN、3D-CNN 和基於圖的 AU 基準，特別是在與疲勞 (AU45, AU43) 和打哈欠 (AU26) 相關的低強度和快速過渡的 AU 上有一致的改進。我們進一步展示該模型在嵌入式 Jetson Xavier NX 平台上維持實時吞吐量，支持其在生產級先進駕駛輔助系統 (ADAS) 中的應用。
